excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气极其稀薄，但似乎有风一样的东西在吹拂着它表面的沙海。
excerpt.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气极其稀薄，但似乎有风一样的东西在吹拂着它表面的沙海。

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气极其稀薄，但似乎有风一样的东西在吹拂着它表面的沙海。
sections.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.

texts.zh:
事实证明，荒芜的[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]毫无有趣之处。

当船员们监视着了无动静的仪器时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]闲来无事查看了[Root.GetName]的能源储备情况。根据他们的报告，[Root.GetName]上次离港时获得的能量补给少于标准量，不过更有可能是[Root.GetLeaderName]对于资源管理的松懈造成了此次窘境。

不管怎么说，这艘船需要更多的能量作为补给。
texts.en:
The desert [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] turned out to be rather unremarkable.

While the crew monitored silent instruments, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was idly eyeing the [Root.GetName]'s energy reserves. According to their report the [Root.GetName] was issued less than the standard amount of energy when it last left port, but is more likely that [Root.GetLeaderName]'s carefree approach to resource management is to blame for the deficit.

Regardless, the ship does need additional Energy Credits.

texts.zh:
事实证明，荒芜的[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]毫无有趣之处。

当船员们监视着了无动静的仪器时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对[Root.GetName]的能源储备进行了认真盘点。根据他们的报告，[Root.GetName]上次离港时获得的能量补给多于标准量，这很可能是书写错误造成的。

[Root.Leader.GetName]已提出要自愿将多余的能量交还给[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]当局。
texts.en:
The desert [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] turned out to be rather unremarkable.

While the crew monitored silent instruments, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was conscientiously taking inventory of the [Root.GetName]'s energy reserves. According to their report the [Root.GetName] was issued more than the standard amount of energy when it last left port, probably due to some clerical error.

[Root.Leader.GetName] has volunteered to return the excess to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities.

texts.zh:
从荒芜的[From.GetName]星球回来时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]带回来了一张用植物纤维做成的针织物。虽然不清楚其来历和用途，但是实验证明了此物的吸水性极好。虽然此物对科学研究毫无帮助，不过[Root.GetLeaderName]却对它情有独钟，无论去哪里都把该物品随身携带。

“[Root.GetLeaderName]真是个奇人。”船员们私底下评论道。
texts.en:
Returning from the desolate surface of [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] brings with them a sheet of woven plant fiber. Its exact origin and purpose is unknown, but it has proven quite absorbent in tests. While useless to the sciences, [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken a shine to the thing and now carries it with them wherever they go.

"Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is a real hoopy frood," the crew whisper.

texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称，我们犯了个愚蠢的错误，在[From.GetName]沙漠看到的沙海涟漪其实是启动的飞船推进器造成的。

有一艘外星飞船头朝下埋没在沙海中，其断断续续工作的推进系统在上方的沙丘激起了阵阵波涛。看来这玩意已经困在这里有段时间了，它在推进器的作用下渐渐插进了沙丘深处。[Root.GetName]没有能够将此船吊出的设备与方法，[Root.GetLeaderName]建议派遣一只飞船到[From.GetName]，以对其进行发掘。
texts.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the waves seen rippling across the sandy seas of [From.GetName] are, bizarrely enough, the result of active ship thrusters.

An alien vessel lies buried in the sand nose-down, its sputtering propulsion systems weakly agitating the dunes above. It appears to have been down there for some time, slowly driving itself deeper into the desert dunes. The [Root.GetName] lacks the means to excavate the struggling ship, and [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends sending a military vessel to [From.GetName] to unearth it.

label.zh: 这么明显的陷阱，我们可不会上当。
label.en: We will not take the obvious bait.

label.zh: 任何剩余的有机生物都将被消灭。
label.en: If there are any organics left they will be terminated.

texts.zh: 可派一支军事舰队尝试打捞这艘一直被掩埋的舰船。
texts.en: A military fleet can attempt to salvage an ever-burrowing ship.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]终于成功将外星飞船打捞了出来。

但它是空的，或者可以说，被拆的什么都没剩了。

原船员一定是将不是很重要的东西全拆掉后便弃船而去，留下这艘空壳在[From.From.GetName]沉没。[Root.GetFleetName]的工程师忙活了好一阵子，终于将其能量补充完毕并重启了飞船。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] eventually succeeds in raising the submerged alien vessel.

It is empty. Almost stripped bare, in fact.

Its crew must have abandoned ship before it was left to burrow into the particulate surface of [From.From.GetName], and they took most of the ship's non-critical internals with them. The engineers of the [Root.GetFleetName] have managed to essentially hotwire the vessel, and have replenished its dwindling energy stores.

label.en: A fresh commission for the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] fleet.

texts.zh: [Root.GetFleetName]使用高强度拉索最终成功打捞起了沉没的外星飞船，却同时也听到了其武器系统启动的轰鸣声！
texts.en: The [Root.GetFleetName]'s high-tensile wires eventually managed to raise the submerged alien vessel, only to be met by the recognizable whirring of weapons systems powering up!

texts.zh:
回收行动失败了。[Root.GetFleetName]绕在舰船上的高强度拉索在向上提拉时的瞬间就将腐蚀殆尽的舰体切成了数段。

单独的碎块回收起来还相对容易，但整个飞船已变成了废铁。
texts.en:
The salvage attempt failed. The high-tensile tethers that the [Root.GetFleetName] had wrapped around the burrowing ship effortlessly sliced through the vessel's corroded hull as raising was attempted.

The individual pieces were then relatively easy to retrieve, but the whole thing is reduced to scrap.

## 如何开始 How it starts

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 三个结局：3035“盘点”（基础0；领队有严谨/粗心特质且能量储备≥50时+1）、3135“保持冷静”（权重1）、3060“沙中缩头”（权重1）。  
  Three outcomes: 3035 Taking Stock (base 0; +1 if the leader is meticulous/carefree and energy stock >= 50), 3135 Stay Calm (weight 1), 3060 Head in the Sand (weight 1).
- 3060选项a/c→HEAD_IN_SAND_PROJECT（需军事舰队）→随机三选一：3061得到空舰/3062敌对战舰/3063失败；失败后可重试（树中的回环）。  
  3060 options a/c → HEAD_IN_SAND_PROJECT (military fleet) → one of 3061 empty ship / 3062 hostile ship / 3063 failure, 33% each; the project can be restarted (loop in the tree).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 结局互斥；3061/3062/3063为项目随机结果。  
  Outcomes are exclusive; 3061/3062/3063 are random project results.

  3035 weight depends on leader traits.
